# Files this branch is allowed to touch, enforced by tools/git-hooks/pre-push.
# PROJECT.md, CHANGELOG.md and this file are always allowed.
#
# `*` matches within one path segment; `**` crosses slashes. So tools/** is
# needed to reach tools/git-hooks/, and .github/pr-scope/** to reach the nested
# per-branch files.
